Copied unmodified from Amy's scifi-ui library on 2026-09-19, at commit
43857a2 (2026-09-15):

  https://github.com/amyleesterling/scifi-ui

  hologram.css        the main set: the holoframe with its HUD corner
                      brackets, the panel and readout surfaces, tokens at
                      the top (site.css redefines the tokens for this
                      site's palette; the file itself is untouched)
  hologram-tap.js     the tap layer that puts .holo-on on anything with a
                      hover treatment, so the brackets and the scan pass
                      are reachable on a screen with no pointer. The
                      library's rule: load it on any page that loads any
                      part of the library.
  panel-surface.css   .holopanel, the dark gradient panel with the lit top
                      hairline and the materialise entrance (is-in)
  scan-pass.css       .holoscan, a scan line that passes once

Consumers: index.html only. The polity card (#tip) is built on .holopanel
and .holoframe, carries the frame's four HUD brackets and a scan line, and
plays the materialise each time it opens (js/app.js adds is-in). civ.html
loads none of this.

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, copy the same four down from a newer
commit and update the commit above. Licence: see the repository.
